blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — At least three local government units (LGUs) in Sultan Kudarat have suspended in-person classes for Monday following reported school threats after a fatal shooting at Banga National High School (BNHS) in neighboring South Cotabato. READ: Campus shooter ‘planned attack, warned classmates’ In Lebak, classes at all levels in both public and private schools will be canceled tomorrow, Sept. 21, after authorities received reports of an alleged shooting threat involving schools in the municipality. The Lebak LGU said the suspension was imposed as a precaution while authorities investigated the reported threat. Additional security personnel would also be deployed to […]...
